fato_historico: 1926: A hurricane devastates Miami, Florida, killing 372 people.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a shift in your emotional landscape, reminding you that resilience is your greatest asset. Much like the winds that once tested the foundations of coastal lands, you possess an unshakeable spirit. It is a good time to ground yourself in your values, nurture your sanctuary, and find beauty in the quiet strength you carry within.
frase_do_dia: Even the strongest winds cannot shake a heart rooted in deep self-love.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of abundance and inner wisdom through persistent effort.
conselho: Focus on building your stability and cherish the comforts of your home today.
